library_preparation_preflight.summary: liquibase-core is DB-agnostic and needs no Docker/DB beyond the existing H2 in-memory setup, but the OSGi-related code path (liquibase.osgi.Activator and CustomChangeWrapper's OSGi classloader branch) is unreachable without org.osgi:osgi.core on the test classpath. This exact fix was already applied for liquibase-core 5.0.1/5.0.3 in this repo to raise coverage, and the same classes exist in 4.17.0's jar but the current 4.17.0 scaffold lacks the dependency.

deterministic_setup.reason: Needed to compile/exercise liquibase.osgi.Activator and the OSGi-classloader branch of CustomChangeWrapper.setClass, which are unreachable via plain JDBC/H2 tests. Same dependency was added for liquibase-core 5.0.1 and 5.0.3 in this repo for the identical reason.

library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: No env vars or system properties are required; liquibase-core has no bundled JDBC drivers (it's DB-agnostic), so continue using the existing H2 in-memory database for functional coverage — do not add Docker or another DB. To exercise the OSGi path once osgi.core is available, mirror tests/src/org.liquibase/liquibase-core/5.0.1/src/test/java/org_liquibase/liquibase_core/CustomChangeWrapperTest.java: instantiate liquibase.osgi.Activator, register a test Bundle via activator.addingBundle(...), and call CustomChangeWrapper.setClass(...) inside Scope.child(Scope.Attr.osgiPlatform, true, ...) to force the OSGi classloader branch, then call activator.removedBundle(...) in a finally block. Also check whether 5.0.1's additional-entries.json reflect-config gaps (PreconditionContainer setOnSqlOutput/setOnFail/setOnError not detected by the tracing agent) still apply to 4.17.0 if those preconditions are exercised.
risks: The OSGi Activator/BundleContext APIs may differ slightly across liquibase-core versions; verify the 5.0.1 CustomChangeWrapperTest pattern compiles against 4.17.0 before relying on it.
